workflow.note: Employee submits (or accepts) the MSR; the Role Execution Agent assesses it against the employee's work-role REQ and tags aligned tasks or a potential new task requirement, and separately against every other REQ on the contract (similar work, collaboration opportunities); the lead of the employee's TTO reviews (including the lead's own MSR); the PMO approves and publishes task alignments with employee data (name, ID, role, TTO), never the MSR input. Contract PMO staff have no TTO; a PMO teammate other than the author reviews their MSRs instead.
